name: Cleansing Ritual
description:
You have helped the Madumareans in their work cleansing their corrupted shores.

Once per day, you may spend one hour attempting to cleanse the area around you of corruption. Roll Spirit against a Difficulty equal to the number of square miles you're attempting to cleanse. On a pass, roll Craft against the same Difficulty. On a second success, the area is cleansed. Remove the Corrupted tag from the current biome, permanently.

Describe the ritual.
